summary: DeepSeek released a patch update to its deepseek-harness developer tool with UI improvements, bug fixes, and removal of the optional SQLite session persistence backend.

practices.reason: Teams relying on the SQLite session persistence backend need to export existing content with an older version before upgrading, since the backend is being removed.
practices.quote: Remove the optional SQLite Session persistence backend; existing content is not deleted, so use an older version to export it
